summary: Stage A/B certification run in PREVIEW, using the public URL and synthetic TEST_ data. No customer emails were sent: CM_RENEWAL_EMAIL_LIVE and MOD_QUOTE_NOTIFY_LIVE are false, as confirmed by /api/build-info. I extended tests/test_afs_large_doc_uploads_jan2026.py to 41 tests: 37 pass and 4 fail. The 4 failures are 1 intermittent and 2 deterministic. A 3rd deterministic failure (the apply-gate test) failed only because of a test-side problem, which is now fixed and passes on rerun. PASSING: (1) Structured CSV pricing, 700 rows: all 700 service prices, 20 travel rates and 5 repair rates match the cells exactly. Reconciliation is source_rows 725 = verified 725 with blocking 0, coverage method is 'structured cells' and complete is true. (2) Multi-sheet xlsx: the same name with the same price across sheets is merged into 1 entry with 2 source_rows. The same name with different prices (30 / 35) gives 2 entries, both needs_review, with a review_reason. Separate location travel rates are exact. POA gives review, a blank price gives invalid, and a Total row is excluded. Counts are 10 source rows, 7 verified, blocking 4, complete false. (3) Small mixed PDF: qty 1, qty 2 with 2 serials on one line, and qty 10 are all verified. 1 serial with qty 3 keeps 3 and gets serial_mismatch. 2 identical Stepper lines are kept separate, both verified at qty 1. The spare part gets spare_part and is excluded. (4) Apply gate: an accepted line with quantity null gives 400 'quantity could not be read'. With decisions[].quantity=2 it returns 200, the quantity is saved as 2 with qty_validation confirmed_by_coordinator, and 2 equipment records are created in the TEST org. (5) build-custom-quote with save=true returns 422 when a rate has needs_review, when source_blocking>0, or when the reason is under 10 characters, and no review row is written. Preview with save=false returns 200. Save with a valid reason returns 200 and writes a crm2_afs_rate_reviews row (unresolved 2, by, reason). (6) Renewal lifecycle: approve-send sets status renewal_approved with email state awaiting_dispatch, no renewal_issued_at, and no auto_renewal_sent_at on the previous contract. The activity subject reads 'approved — awaiting issue'. dispatch_queued_renewals returns {live:false} and changes nothing. mark-issued returns 403 for the coordinator, 422 when the evidence is 4 characters or fewer, and 200 for cm.aftersales, which sets status sent, issued_via manual, issued_at, and auto_renewal_sent_at on the previous contract. A second mark-issued returns 409, and cancel-email afterwards returns 409. (7) Jobs: 2 concurrent from-file POSTs got 1 job_id, and exactly one response had joined=true. A running job with a heartbeat 10 minutes old is returned by GET jobs/{id} as failed and interrupted with a Retry message, and active_key is unset. The retry POST creates a new job that completes. A stale active job does not block a new POST. (8) build-info: 401 with no token, 403 for staff, and 200 for the master admin with commit, fingerprint.combined, started_at and flags. (9) UI as cm.aftersales, Renewals: the label 'Approved — awaiting issue (email queued; live renewal emails are off)' shows with the Mark issued and Cancel customer email buttons, and no Resend. Both open an inline dialog with no window.prompt; Confirm stays disabled under 5 characters. The success toasts appear and the labels change to 'Issued manually (recorded by a manager)' and 'Approved — customer email cancelled, not issued'. The DB state matched. (10) UI as coordinator, Custom tender: uploading the xlsx shows the amber block afs-aq-pricing-upload-blocking listing 4 issues, plus the reason input. FAILING: (A) Missing printed quantity: the AI value is kept. 'PF-RW-200 ... Serial X' with no Qty came back as quantity=1, qty_validation=unverified, and no quantity_unconfirmed flag. This happened in 2 of 2 runs and is a silent default to 1. (B) Invalid 'Qty two' came back as quantity=2, unverified, not invalid and not null. This happened in 2 of 2 runs; it was blocked only by chance, through serial_mismatch. (C) The 400-line invoice is intermittent: the full-suite run returned 321 of 400 lines (642 units), yet coverage reported complete:true with parts_read 5/5. A direct rerun of extract_document returned 400/400, all verified. One LLM part silently returned far fewer lines (321 = 4×80 + 1) and nothing detected it. The serial, page and verified checks on the 400-line import could therefore not be confirmed through the API run; the direct rerun showed 400 verified with all serials.

critical.issue: When the source line is found but has no printed Qty, qty_validation is 'unverified' and the AI's quantity is kept. The AI fills in 1, so the quantity is never null and quantity_unconfirmed is never raised. This breaks the rule 'never default to 1' (2 of 2 runs).
'Qty two' does not match the digit-only regex, so the line is 'unverified' and keeps the AI's 2 instead of qty_validation=invalid with quantity=null (2 of 2 runs).

Intermittent: the 400-line invoice returned 321 lines (642 units), yet coverage.complete was true and parts_read was 5/5. A part whose JSON parses but holds far fewer lines than its section has rows is counted as read. There is no per-part check of line count against the source rows. Failed 1 of 2 runs (50%).

minor.issue: The gate trusts needs_review and source_blocking as sent by the client, so a direct API caller can leave them out and save unreviewed rates. Also, the crm2_afs_rate_reviews row is inserted before the linked-org and estate checks, so a save that then fails with 400 leaves an orphan review row.

The name column is the first header matching _NAME_H, which includes 'item'. With headers ['Item code','Description','Price'], the code column would be used as the name. Prefer description/machine/type/location over item or code.

ui_bugs.issue: Mark issued and Cancel customer email are shown to users without renewals.approve, such as the coordinator, who then gets a 403 toast. Hide them or disable them with a tooltip based on permission.

design_issues.screen: Build Quote → Custom tender → coverage note
issues: The structured xlsx note reads 'Document only partly read — check before relying on it' when every row was read and only the review items block the save. The wording should say the whole document was read and N rows need review.
Each conflicting rate is listed once per conflicting entry, so the same 'Different prices…' line appears twice. The block heading counts 4, which double-counts the conflict.

action_items: verify_quantities: when the line is found but has no numeric Qty, set quantity=None and qty_validation='missing' (or 'unverified' with quantity None), so match_lines adds quantity_unconfirmed. Never keep the AI value unless the printed value confirms it. Also change the prompt to allow "quantity": int|null.
verify_quantities: detect a non-numeric value after Qty/Quantity/Units (for example 'Qty two', 'Qty -') and set qty_validation='invalid' with quantity=None.

extract_document: per section, count the expected rows (for example lines with a serial pattern, an item code or 'Qty N'). If the AI returned materially fewer lines, retry that part once, then mark it parts_failed and set coverage.complete=false. Do not report complete:true when 79 lines are missing.

build_custom_quote: work out unresolved rates on the server from the pricing job result (job id or reconciliation) instead of trusting client flags. Insert the review row only after the save succeeds.
Optional: fix the structured pricing name-column choice, the coverage wording for structured cells, the duplicate conflict lines, and permission-aware renewal buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: The 400-line test now asserts that every line is verified at qty 2, that the serial set is exact, that the source page matches the serial's page, that there are no unexplained corrections, and that source_text contains 'Qty 2'.
Heartbeat: beat() updates heartbeat_at every 30 s, but this was checked by code review only. The successful jobs ran too briefly to see a beat through the API.
_start_job: create_index on every call is redundant (cheap but noisy). asyncio.wait_for TimeoutError is fine on Python 3.11.
build_info allows any org 'owner' or 'admin' role (any tenant), not only Pulse admins. The flags shown are non-sensitive booleans, so this is acceptable but worth noting.
crm_aftersales.py is 4553 lines. It should be split into modules.

success_rate.backend: 90% (37/41 passed in the extended suite: 2 deterministic quantity bugs, 1 intermittent line drop on the 400-line invoice, 1 test-side failure in the apply-gate test, now fixed and passing on rerun)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the flows tested (renewal dialogs, tender blocking block)

seed_data_creation: Only temporary TEST_lg_* and TEST_ui_* companies, contracts, org, site, service config, files, jobs and equipment, all deleted by id afterwards (I checked that 0 remain). UI-uploaded TEST_ui_tender_mixed.xlsx file and job deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_afs_large_doc_uploads_jan2026.py -v -s -o addopts=''. Cheap subset with a small LLM call: -k 'TestSmallMixedInvoice or TestBlockIncompleteRates'. With no LLM at all: -k 'TestStructuredXlsx or TestJobReliability or TestBuildInfo or TestRenewal or TestPricingJob'. The OP org has no crm2_afs_service_configs, so the apply test inserts a TEST config. If the quantity bug is still present, the apply test simulates a null quantity on line 5. The 400-line LLM run is about 70 s and was flaky (321/400 once). UI: login, then launch-contract_management, then crm-nav-renewals for cm-renewal-* testids, or crm-nav-build-quote with afs-aq-type=custom and the upload input afs-aq-pricing-upload-file. The customer dropdown for the coordinator showed no options, so a UI save of a custom quote was not exercised; the 422 gate was tested only via the API. Seed helper for UI renewals: /tmp/rca/ui_seed.py (run 'clean' after).
rca of the issue: Quantity defaults: cm_quote_import._PROMPT asks for "quantity": int, so the model always returns a number, which is 1 when nothing is printed and 2 for 'two'. In verify_quantities, when _QTY (digits only) does not match the found line, the code sets qty_validation='unverified' and leaves ln['quantity'] as the AI value. match_lines then sees a valid integer and adds no quantity_unconfirmed. Reproduced: line 'PF-RW-200 Pulse Rower 200 Serial SNM..05' gives quantity 1, and 'PF-XT-500 ... Qty two Serial SNM..06' gives quantity 2, in 2 of 2 runs. Fix: on a found line with no numeric qty, set quantity=None. Line drop: extract_document counts any part whose JSON parses as read. One of the 5 parts (80 rows each) returned about 1 line, so 321 of 400 lines came back and coverage still said complete. A direct rerun gave 400/400. Fix: a per-part check of expected rows against returned lines, with a retry.
